nodes.name: Plan (match stock)
nodes.notes: Priority: Ameri Stock, Shipster Stock, Ameeri Return, Shipster Return, Faisal Return. Match = product + size + material with status In.

nodes.name: Set Warehouse + US WH SKU
nodes.notes: incoterm_location = the field shown as 'US WH SKU'

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'call', id: 1, params: { service: 'common', method: 'login', args: [ $('Config').first().json.odooDb, $('Config').first().json.odooLogin, $('Config').first().json.odooApiKey ] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'call', id: 2, params: { service: 'object', method: 'execute_kw', args: [ $('Config').first().json.odooDb, $json.uid, $('Config').first().json.odooApiKey, 'sale.order', 'action_confirm', [[ $json.order_id ]] ] } }) }}

nodes.name: Get MCF Activities
nodes.notes: Orders with an 'MCF' activity (e.g. MCF, LATE MCF) are skipped completely: no stock, no remark, no confirm

nodes.name: OC: Get Other Country Orders
nodes.notes: Same as Odoo filter 'AZ Other ctry Orders' (country is not United States, filtered in the Plan step)

filter.value: ={{ $('OC: Get Other Country Orders').all().map(i => i.json).filter(o => o.id && !/united states/i.test(o.x_studio_country || '') && (!$('Config').first().json.testOrder || o.name === String($('Config').first().json.testOrder).trim().toUpperCase())).map(o => o.id) }}

={{ $('OC: Get Other Country Orders').all().map(i => i.json).filter(o => o.id && !/united states/i.test(o.x_studio_country || '') && (!$('Config').first().json.testOrder || o.name === String($('Config').first().json.testOrder).trim().toUpperCase())).filter(o => o.has_archived_products).map(o => o.id) }}
={{ $('OC: Lines of Archived Orders').all().map(i => i.json.product_id && i.json.product_id[0]).filter(Boolean) }}
={{ [...new Set($('OC: Lines of Archived Orders').all().flatMap(i => [i.json.asin, i.json.amazon_asin]).filter(a => a && String(a).trim()).map(a => String(a).trim()))] }}
={{ [...new Set($('OC: Lines of Archived Orders').all().flatMap(i => [i.json.asin, i.json.amazon_asin]).filter(a => a && String(a).trim()).map(a => String(a).trim()))] }}
={{ [...new Set([...$('OC: Same ASIN (field 1)').all(), ...$('OC: Same ASIN (field 2)').all()].map(i => i.json).filter(l => l.id).map(l => l.product_id && l.product_id[0]).filter(Boolean))] }}

={{ [...new Set([...$('OC: Same ASIN (field 1)').all(), ...$('OC: Same ASIN (field 2)').all()].map(i => i.json).filter(l => l.id).map(l => l.product_template_id && l.product_template_id[0]).filter(Boolean))] }}

nodes.name: OC: Plan (fix product + confirm)
nodes.notes: Other-country orders: archived product -> pick product by ASIN; real product -> confirm. No warehouse check. MCF activity -> skipped.
